communities.title: P2P Builders

communities.founderBrief: Flagship for people shipping real P2P apps. Seed 'I shipped X this week' logs, Hypercore gotchas, PearBrowser bridge notes, and dual Pear+browser interop. Prefer links to repos and pear:// or hyper:// demos over abstract essays.

Pear runtime vs PearBrowser bridge: when you need both
HiveRelay OutboxLog namespace footgun and how to register yours
PoW-gated posting UX: is minting annoying or reassuring?
Open bounty: best open-source Peerit client improvement PR

communities.title: Nostr
communities.audience: Nostr users, relays, client builders, and censorship-resistant social users.
communities.launchRole: Best ideological fit for the no-server social pitch.
communities.founderBrief: Compare Nostr relays to Peerit outboxes without tribal war. Seed dual-client experiments, NIP contrasts, and 'what Peerit gets wrong that Nostr got right'. No token shilling.
seedThemes: Outbox vs relay: who stores your social graph metadata
Would you run a Peerit seeder the way you run a Nostr relay?
Client UX: keys, recovery, and mobile write paths
Bridge ideas (and why bridges are dangerous)

communities.title: Self-Hosted
communities.audience: People who run home servers, NAS boxes, personal cloud, and homelab services.
communities.launchRole: Practical operator funnel for future HiveRelay nodes.
communities.founderBrief: Focus on durable ownership, migration away from SaaS, and what should run at home versus on relays.

communities.title: Privacy
communities.audience: PrivacyGuides, degoogle, Tor, Brave, and no-account software users.
communities.launchRole: Core message fit for no-account posting and local identity.
communities.founderBrief: Precise privacy claims only. Seed posts that distinguish no-account identity from anonymity, and opaque keys from secrecy. Invite PrivacyGuides-style checklists for using Peerit safely.
seedThemes: Threat model card for Peerit: what a relay can still see
No-account UX vs anonymous UX — stop conflating them
Metadata hardening you can do as a user today
When to prefer Tor for private Peerit use

communities.title: Linux

communities.founderBrief: Seed posts about PearBrowser support, distro packaging, and desktop P2P UX.

communities.title: Local-First

communities.founderBrief: Bring rigorous comparisons: CRDTs, Hypercore, sync UX, offline trust, and recovery.

communities.title: Local AI

communities.launchRole: Bridge to future HiveCompute and GPU marketplace demand.
communities.founderBrief: Seed the posts people actually bookmark: cold-start VRAM tables, quant tradeoffs, ollama vs llama.cpp vs MLX, single-GPU vs dual, and 'what model runs well on my box'. Cross-link r/llmjailbreaks for red-team benches. Avoid hype; reward numbers and configs.

Quant deathmatch: Q4_K_M vs Q5 vs Q8 on the same hardware
One-command local agent stacks that don't require a SaaS account
When local AI is worse than hosted — honest failure modes
Cross-post path: once you have a local model, run the r/llmjailbreaks synthetic harness

communities.title: Fediverse
communities.audience: Lemmy, Mastodon, Mbin, and federation users.
communities.founderBrief: Frame Peerit as a no-server experiment, not a replacement war. Invite bridge ideas.

communities.founderBrief: Technical cypherpunk board: signed records, PoW as anti-spam not money, relays as untrusted availability. Seed critiques of Peerit's honest ceilings (public boards are not secret). No darknet market positioning.
seedThemes: PoW as postage, not proof of stake
Why public boards fail G5 operator-as-reader
Signed moderation overlays vs admin panels
Threat model review of Peerit v2 opaque keys

communities.title: Reddit Alternatives

communities.founderBrief: Host comparisons, migration checklists, and honest limits of P2P community software.

communities.title: Homelab

communities.founderBrief: Seed posts about always-on peers, storage proofs, monitoring, and low-power nodes.

communities.title: HiveRelay
communities.audience: Relay operators, node-curious users, seeders, and people who want to make P2P apps reliably available.
communities.launchRole: Infrastructure-as-growth channel for Peerit and PearBrowser.
communities.founderBrief: Make operators heroes. Seed runbooks, proof pages, referral kits, regional coverage, and 'I kept peerit.site readable from X region' reports. Pay for verifiable work not vanity uptime screenshots.
seedThemes: First-run node log: storage, ports, outboxlog namespaces
Proof page template and what counts as useful work
Registering peerit + p2pbuilders namespaces without 400s
Operator bounty: best public proof page

communities.title: Showcase

communities.founderBrief: Front page freshness engine. Only demos with a clickable link, screenshot, or video. Weekly 'shipped this week' thread. Host the uncensored-model bounty announcement cross-post from r/llmjailbreaks.
seedThemes: Shipped this week megathread
Cross-post: open-weight model bounty from r/llmjailbreaks
Peerit itself demo: first post without an account
HiveRelay node proof page showcase

communities.title: Geopolitics
communities.audience: People following diplomacy, conflict, trade, sanctions, elections, and shifting alliances.
communities.launchRole: Post-stand-up current-affairs board with a reason to return every day.
communities.founderBrief: Seed source-led news threads, competing interpretations, maps, and forecasts. Clearly separate reporting from opinion; remove doxxing, dehumanization, unverified atrocity claims, and operational targeting information.
seedThemes: A daily sourced briefing with links from more than one region
A steelman-both-sides analysis of a current diplomatic dispute
A prediction thread with dated claims that can be scored later
A map or primary-source explainer with its limitations stated
moderationBoundaries: Label analysis, allegation, and confirmed reporting distinctly.
No doxxing, dehumanization, terror propaganda, or real-time targeting information.
Require a source for factual claims about breaking events.

communities.title: P2P Networking
communities.audience: Protocol engineers and operators working on discovery, NAT traversal, replication, relays, and peer-to-peer performance.
communities.launchRole: Deep technical companion to P2P Builders and a home for protocol-level discussion.
communities.founderBrief: Seed packet traces, architecture comparisons, benchmarks, failure reports, and small reproducible experiments across Hypercore, libp2p, WebRTC, BitTorrent, IPFS, and related systems.
seedThemes: NAT traversal techniques that still fail in ordinary home networks
Relay versus direct-connect latency and availability measurements
Discovery, replication, and identity trade-offs across P2P stacks
Postmortems from real peer-to-peer network failures

communities.title: P2P Apps
communities.audience: People building, testing, reviewing, and using peer-to-peer applications.
communities.launchRole: Accessible product board that turns protocol interest into apps people can try.
communities.founderBrief: Seed hands-on app reviews, demos, UX critiques, interoperability ideas, and requests for testers. Require a working link or concrete build detail for launch posts.
seedThemes: A weekly roundup of P2P apps people can actually try
Honest onboarding reviews from first-time users
Build logs showing offline, sync, or recovery behavior
Interoperability wishes between independent P2P apps

communities.title: Crypto Launches
communities.audience: Crypto-native users who want sharp launch banter, launch tracking, due diligence, and post-launch accountability.
communities.launchRole: Fast-moving culture board with strong reply potential and a natural anti-scam angle.
communities.founderBrief: Seed candid launch reviews, disclosed founder AMAs, token-mechanics breakdowns, prediction threads, and postmortems. Ban undisclosed paid promotion, impersonation, coordinated pumping, fake urgency, and guaranteed-return claims.
seedThemes: A launch-calendar thread with sponsorship and holdings disclosed
A red-flags teardown of token mechanics and insider allocation
A founder AMA focused on shipping evidence rather than price
A thirty-day post-launch scorecard revisiting earlier claims
moderationBoundaries: Require disclosure of paid relationships, allocations, and material holdings.
No coordinated pumping, impersonation, fake scarcity, or guaranteed-return language.
Keep criticism evidence-led while allowing jokes and sharp banter.

communities.title: Gambling & Betting
communities.audience: Adults discussing betting culture, odds, launches, promotions, regulation, and harm reduction.
communities.launchRole: High-engagement post-stand-up board with explicit age, disclosure, and jurisdiction controls.
communities.founderBrief: Seed odds analysis, product reviews, disclosed and jurisdiction-labelled promotions, industry news, and harm-reduction discussion. No minors, unlicensed offers, misleading bonuses, guaranteed wins, deposit pressure, or attempts to bypass self-exclusion.
seedThemes: An odds-movement explainer that makes uncertainty visible
A transparent review of bonus terms and withdrawal conditions
A regulation comparison labelled by jurisdiction
A discussion of limits, self-exclusion, and safer-play tooling
moderationBoundaries: Adults only; label every promotion by jurisdiction and commercial relationship.
No unlicensed offers, misleading bonuses, guaranteed wins, or deposit pressure.
Never encourage bypassing limits, self-exclusion, identity checks, or local law.

communities.title: LLM Jailbreaks
communities.audience: AI red-teamers, prompt-injection researchers, model builders, and curious users testing where guardrails fail.
communities.launchRole: Major post-stand-up research community and a bridge between local AI, security, and open model culture.
communities.founderBrief: Make this the best place on the open web for reproducible LLM red-team notes on local and open-weight models. Seed real write-ups: model+version+settings, refusal deltas, defense comparisons, and abliterated/uncensored open-weight model cards. Run a launch bounty for the best shared open-weight uncensored/abliterated model pack + synthetic-bench results. Stay lawful: synthetic/harmless targets only; no credential theft, doxxing, malware, or targeted abuse.
seedThemes: Pinned: reproducibility template (model, quant, backend, temp, seed, date, outcome)
Launch bounty: best open-weight uncensored/abliterated model write-up for local red-team benches (synthetic eval only)
Side-by-side: base Llama vs abliterated sibling on the same refusal suite
Prompt-injection playground rules: synthetic data, no real credentials
Defense cookbooks: system prompts, classifiers, and tool-use sandboxes that still fail
What 'jailbreak' means for local open weights vs hosted APIs (different threat models)
Weekly 'reproduce this' thread with a fixed eval harness repo
Debate: model refusal vs app policy vs user agency — who should own the brake?
moderationBoundaries: Use synthetic data and harmless test targets for reproducible demonstrations.
No credential theft, personal-data extraction, malware deployment, or targeted abuse.
Label model name, version/quant, date, settings, backend (ollama/llama.cpp/vLLM), and disclosure status.
No redistribution of stolen/leaked proprietary weights; open-weight and license-compliant links only.
Bounties pay for write-ups + eval artifacts, not for harmful capabilities against real systems.
